objects.description: During the [AI-Assisted Breach of Mexico's Government Infrastructure](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0064), the adversary requested Claude Code to add a skills file titled claude.md to the project root direct that loads automatically at the start of every Claude Code session.  During the [AI-Assisted Breach of Mexico's Government Infrastructure](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0064), the adversary also routinely updated the skills file to take note of changes and findings.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)
